descriptions.NORMAL: Normal retinal structure with well-preserved foveal depression and intact retinal layers without intraretinal or subretinal fluid.
descriptions.DME: Diabetic Macular Edema characterized by cystoid intraretinal fluid accumulation and retinal thickening.
descriptions.DRUSEN: Drusen deposits presenting as focal sub-RPE nodular elevations between retinal pigment epithelium and Bruch membrane.
descriptions.CNV: Choroidal Neovascularization characterized by pathologic neovascular membranes piercing Bruch membrane with subretinal hyperreflective material.

screening_rules.recommendation: Urgent retinal specialist consultation recommended for anti-VEGF therapy evaluation.
Ophthalmological evaluation recommended for diabetic macular edema management.
Comprehensive eye examination recommended to assess age-related macular degeneration.
